mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 0.3% in 3 months signals weakening labor market confidence, leading to negative 5-day forward returns as investors anticipate economic slowdown.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative despite UNRATE exceeding 0.3% threshold, or returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent expansion in both demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) indices signals robust economic growth, driving positive 60-day forward returns as market anticipates sustained demand for goods.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.05 over 3-month rolling window, or returns are not significantly positive when both GDPC1 and INDPRO are rising.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in housing demand (HOUST) above 2000 units in 2 months indicates strong consumer confidence, driving positive 20-day forward returns as housing sector growth boosts equity values.
regime_hint: rising housing demand in recovery phase
failure_condition: 20-day returns not positive when HOUST exceeds threshold, or returns are negative despite high HOUST.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS increasing), higher interest rates reduce discount rates on equities, leading to negative 5-day forward returns as investors anticipate lower growth.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain negative when FEDFUNDS are in tightening phase, or returns are positive in >50% of instances during tightening.

mechanism_narrative: Rising employment (PAYEMS) coupled with falling unemployment (UNRATE) signals labor market tightening, causing negative 60-day forward returns as investors expect slower growth.
failure_condition: Rank IC > 0.1 over 6-month window, or returns are not significantly negative when both PAYEMS and UNRATE move in opposite directions.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in supply (INDPRO) over 3 months indicates robust production growth, boosting equity valuations and driving positive 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not show sustained increase, or 20-day returns are not significantly positive.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion phase (dominant_domain: demand), rising demand (GDPC1) signals peak growth, leading to positive 5-day forward returns as investors adjust valuations upward.
failure_condition: GDPC1 rises but 5-day returns are negative, or returns are not significantly positive during late-cycle periods.
